from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import threading
from collections.abc import Iterator
from datetime import datetime, timezone

MIGRATIONS: list[str] = [
    """
    CREATE TABLE users (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
        password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
        created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    """,
    """
    CREATE TABLE audit_log (
        id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id    INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        event      TEXT    NOT NULL,
        detail     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        created_at TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log(user_id, created_at);
    """,
    """
    CREATE TABLE todos (
        id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
        done        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL,
        updated_at  TEXT    NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX todos_user ON todos(user_id, created_at DESC);
    """,
]

def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")

def connect(path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn

def schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT MAX(id) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_version'").fetchone()
    if row and row[0]:
        return conn.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_version").fetchone()[0]
    return 0

def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (
            id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
            version INTEGER NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    current = schema_version(conn)
    for i, migration in enumerate(MIGRATIONS[current:], start=current):
        conn.executescript(migration)
        conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO schema_version (id, version) VALUES (1, ?)", (i + 1,))
    conn.commit()
    return len(MIGRATIONS)

class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:
        self._path = path
        self._local = threading.local()

    def connections(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        if not hasattr(self._local, "conn"):
            self._local.conn = connect(self._path)
            init_db(self._local.conn)
        yield self._local.conn

_database: Database | None = None

def configure(database: Database) -> None:
    global _database
    _database = database

def get_db() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    if _database is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Database not configured")
    yield from _database.connections()

def audit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event: str, user_id: int | None = None, detail: str = "") -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (user_id, event, detail, utc_now()),
    )

def row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    if row is None:
        return None
    return {key: row[key] for key in row.keys()}

) -> RegisterResponse:
    username = data.username.strip()

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlite3 import Connection
from typing import Optional

from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_db, utc_now, row_to_dict
from app.errors import not_found
from app.pagination import PageParams, page_params, paginate
from app.security import get_current_user, CurrentUser

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/todos", tags=["todos"])

class TodoCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)

class TodoUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    done: Optional[bool] = None

class TodoResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    done: bool
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

class TodoListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[TodoResponse]
    total: int
    limit: int
    offset: int

def _todo_to_response(row: dict) -> TodoResponse:
    return TodoResponse(
        id=row["id"],
        title=row["title"],
        done=bool(row["done"]),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"],
    )

@router.get("", response_model=TodoListResponse, summary="List todos")
def list_todos(
    done: Optional[bool] = None,
    page: PageParams = Depends(page_params),
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoListResponse:
    where = ["user_id = ?"]
    params: list = [user.id]
    if done is not None:
        where.append("done = ?")
        params.append(1 if done else 0)
    where_sql = " AND ".join(where)

    total = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE {where_sql}", params).fetchone()[0]

    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT * FROM todos WHERE {where_sql} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
        (*params, page.limit, page.offset),
    ).fetchall()

    items = [_todo_to_response(row_to_dict(r)) for r in rows]
    return TodoListResponse(**paginate(items, total, page))

@router.post("", response_model=TodoResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a todo")
def create_todo(
    data: TodoCreate,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    title = data.title.strip()
    now = utc_now()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, ?)",
        (user.id, title, now, now),
    )
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()
    return _todo_to_response(row_to_dict(row))

@router.get("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Get a todo")
def get_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", "Todo not found.")
    return _todo_to_response(row_to_dict(row))

@router.patch("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Update a todo")
def update_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    data: TodoUpdate,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> TodoResponse:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", "Todo not found.")

    title = data.title.strip() if data.title is not None else row["title"]
    done = 1 if data.done else 0 if data.done is not None else row["done"]
    now = utc_now()

    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE todos SET title = ?, done = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (title, done, now, todo_id),
    )
    conn.commit()

    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    return _todo_to_response(row_to_dict(row))

@router.delete("/{todo_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, summary="Delete a todo")
def delete_todo(
    todo_id: int,
    user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user),
    conn: Connection = Depends(get_db),
) -> None:
    cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id))
    conn.commit()
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        raise not_found("todo_not_found", "Todo not found.")

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from app import __version__, errors
from app.config import Settings, get_settings, settings_from_env
from app.db import Database, configure
from app.routers import health, auth, todos

FRONTEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend"

def create_app(
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    *,
    db_path: str | None = None,
    secret: str | None = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    if settings is None:
        settings = settings_from_env()
        if db_path is not None:
            settings = Settings(
                db_path=db_path,
                secret=settings.secret,
                token_ttl=settings.token_ttl,
                cors_origins=settings.cors_origins,
                page_size=settings.page_size,
                max_page_size=settings.max_page_size,
            )
        if secret is not None:
            settings = Settings(
                db_path=settings.db_path,
                secret=secret,
                token_ttl=settings.token_ttl,
                cors_origins=settings.cors_origins,
                page_size=settings.page_size,
                max_page_size=settings.max_page_size,
            )
    settings.validate()

    app = FastAPI(title="Taskboard", version=__version__)
    errors.install(app)

    if settings.cors_origins:
        app.add_middleware(
            CORSMiddleware,
            allow_origins=list(settings.cors_origins),
            allow_credentials=True,
            allow_methods=["*"],
            allow_headers=["*"],
        )

    configure(Database(settings.db_path))

    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(auth.router)
    app.include_router(todos.router)

    app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR, html=True), name="frontend")

    return app

def build() -> FastAPI:
    return create_app()

      <form id="auth-form" novalidate>
        <label>

          <input type="text" name="username" required autocomplete="username" maxlength="32">

  <script type="module">
    import { apiFetch, ApiError } from "./js/api.js";
    import { saveToken, isSignedIn, clearToken } from "./js/api.js";
    import { showMessage, el, clear, whileBusy } from "./js/ui.js";

    if (isSignedIn()) {
      location.href = "todos.html";
    }

    let mode = "login"; // "login" or "register"

    const form = document.getElementById("auth-form");
    const title = document.getElementById("form-title");
    const subtitle = document.getElementById("form-subtitle");
    const switchLink = document.getElementById("switch-link");
    const switchBtn = document.getElementById("switch-btn");
    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

    function setMode(m) {
      mode = m;
      if (mode === "login") {
        title.textContent = "Sign in";
        subtitle.innerHTML = 'Or <a href="#" id="switch-link">create an account</a>.';
        submitBtn.textContent = "Sign in";
        switchBtn.hidden = true;
        submitBtn.hidden = false;
      } else {
        title.textContent = "Create account";
        subtitle.innerHTML = 'Already have an account? <a href="#" id="switch-link">Sign in</a>.';
        submitBtn.hidden = true;
        switchBtn.hidden = false;

      // Re-attach click handler to the new link
      document.getElementById("switch-link").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setMode(mode === "login" ? "register" : "login");
      });
      clear(form.querySelector(".message") || null);
    }

    switchLink.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setMode(mode === "login" ? "register" : "login");
    });

    switchBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setMode("login"));

    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());
      data.username = data.username.trim();
      data.password = data.password;

      try {
        if (mode === "login") {
          await whileBusy(form, async () => {
            const res = await apiFetch("/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: data });
            saveToken(res.access_token);
            location.href = "todos.html";
          });
        } else {
          await whileBusy(form, async () => {
            const res = await apiFetch("/api/auth/register", { method: "POST", body: data });
            saveToken(res.access_token);
            location.href = "todos.html";
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError) {
          showMessage(err.message, "error");
        } else {
          showMessage("An unexpected error occurred.", "error");
        }
      }
    });

    import { apiFetch, ApiError, loadToken, clearToken, isSignedIn } from "./js/api.js";
    import { showMessage, el, clear, formatTime } from "./js/ui.js";

    if (!isSignedIn()) {
      location.href = "login.html";
    }

    const PAGE_SIZE = 20;
    let offset = 0;
    let filter = "all"; // "all", "open", "done"
    let total = 0;

    const list = document.getElementById("todo-list");
    const pager = document.getElementById("pager");
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prev-btn");
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById("next-btn");
    const pageInfo = document.getElementById("page-info");
    const addForm = document.getElementById("add-form");
    const signoutBtn = document.getElementById("signout-btn");
    const userNameEl = document.getElementById("user-name");
    const filterRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="filter"]');

    async function loadUser() {
      try {
        const me = await apiFetch("/api/auth/me");
        userNameEl.textContent = me.username;

        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) {

      params.set("limit", String(PAGE_SIZE));

      return params.toString();

      try {
        const data = await apiFetch(`/api/todos?${buildQuery()}`);

        if (err instanceof ApiError) {

        li.append(checkbox, titleSpan, deleteBtn);
        list.appendChild(li);

      const page = Math.floor(offset / PAGE_SIZE) + 1;
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;

      nextBtn.disabled = offset + PAGE_SIZE >= total;

        await apiFetch("/api/todos", { method: "POST", body: { title } });
        loadTodos();
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError) showMessage(err.message, "error");
        else showMessage("Failed to add todo.", "error");

        loadTodos();
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError) showMessage(err.message, "error");

        loadTodos(); // revert UI
      }

    async function renameTodo(id, titleSpan) {
      const current = titleSpan.textContent;
      const input = el("input", { type: "text", value: current, style: "flex: 1;" });
      titleSpan.replaceWith(input);
      input.focus();
      input.select();

      function finish() {
        const newTitle = input.value.trim();
        if (newTitle && newTitle !== current) {
          apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: { title: newTitle } })
            .then(() => loadTodos())
            .catch((err) => {
              if (err instanceof ApiError) showMessage(err.message, "error");
              else showMessage("Failed to rename todo.", "error");
              loadTodos();
            });
        } else {
          input.replaceWith(titleSpan);
        }
      }

      input.addEventListener("blur", finish);
      input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") finish();
        if (e.key === "Escape") { input.replaceWith(titleSpan); }
      });
    }

    async function deleteTodo(id) {
      if (!confirm("Delete this todo?")) return;
      try {
        await apiFetch(`/api/todos/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
        loadTodos();
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError) showMessage(err.message, "error");
        else showMessage("Failed to delete todo.", "error");
      }
    }

      e.preventDefault();
      const title = addForm.title.value.trim();
      if (title) {
        addTodo(title);
        addForm.reset();
      }
    });

    prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      offset = Math.max(0, offset - PAGE_SIZE);
      loadTodos();
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      offset += PAGE_SIZE;
      loadTodos();
    });

    filterRadios.forEach((radio) => {
      radio.addEventListener("change", () => {
        filter = radio.value;
        offset = 0;
        loadTodos();
      });
    });

      clearToken();
      location.href = "login.html";
    });

    loadUser();
    loadTodos();
